description: Listado de antenas de telefonía móvil is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Listado de estaciones base (antenas), en formato excel, de telefonia móvil, por concesionario, comuna y región. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Its tags are Antenas, Telecomunicaciones, telefonía. It offers 33 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2018-09-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
